text:
Samir Patel: Quick sync 1: vendor pack (DeltaCompute + VoltCloud + AuroraEdge) landed. We need standardized inputs for cost model: per-sku reserved price by tenor, spot median+std, blackout windows (maintenance/upgrade), replenishment lead time, commit cliff penalties. Putting ask here so PMs/vendors have one spec.

Talia Ruiz: Can you paste the spec format? I'll forward to contacts at Delta.

Samir Patel: Spec header (CSV):
```
vendor,sku,gpu_family,reserved_3mo_usd,reserved_6mo_usd,reserved_12mo_usd,spot_median_usd,spot_std_usd,blackout_months,lead_time_days,early_term_fee_pct,min_commit,burst_sla_percent,preempt_profile_notes
```
Use `blackout_months` as a semicolon list if multiple windows (e.g., Jun;Dec).

Noah Green: Heads up Delta replied: they only publish spot quantiles (p10/p50/p90) not std. We should accept p10/p50/p90 and convert to mgmt-friendly inputs. Also they flagged a quarterly maintenance freeze (2 days/quarter) as "blackout".

Lara Singh: For marketplace fees: Finance needs `vendor_listing_fee_pct` and `vendor_revenue_share_tier` per sku. Some marketplaces have tiered revenue share if you undercut their min list price.

Samir Patel: Add those columns to the spec and the sheet. Delta/Volt/Aurora samples are in /partners/incoming/oct-uploads.

VendorOpsBot: Ingestion scheduled: task_id=ingest-4421. Waiting for /partners/incoming/oct-uploads/2026-10-delta-pack.zip

Ben Walker: Two practical asks from ops: (1) lead_time_days must be realistic (Delta claims 14-21 days fulfillment for reserved ramp) or else routing calculation breaks; (2) need per-region carveouts (e.g., `us-west-2:10, eu-central-1:5`). Can we accept a `region_capacity_map` free-form column?

Samir Patel: Yes add `region_capacity_map` as a JSON-string field (e.g., "us-west-2:50,eu-central-1:20"). Keep as single CSV cell.

Lara Singh: Legal flagged a clause with Delta: "no public price disclosure" for some enterprise SKUs. If we can't list price publicly on marketplace, that affects sales packaging. Mark `disclosure_allowed` (yes/no) in the sheet.

Noah Green: Delta also proposed a volume discount ladder: 1-99 units = base, 100-499 = -8%, 500+ = -15%, but only for 12mo. They want the ladder in the CSV as `volume_ladder` string. Example: "1:0;100:-8;500:-15".

Samir Patel: Good. Also capture `commit_cliff_months` (months before early-termination penalty reduces) and `clawback_multiplier` for unused committed units transferred to marketplace credits.

VendorOpsBot: ingest-4421 started.

FinanceBot: FYI finance wants to see effective unit cost under these transforms: list -> discounted ladder -> marketplace fee -> revenue share. I'll attach a template column `effective_unit_usd` in the sheet.

Ben Walker: Ops note: preempt_profile_notes need structured tags: LOW_LATENCY_PNP (preempt with 5m notice), NO_NOTICE, 24H_REBALANCE. Helps routing decisions.

Samir Patel: Action items: (1) Talia/Noah: push spec to Delta & Aurora + ask for p10/p50/p90 and region map by EOD Wednesday; (2) Lara: loop legal on disclosure rows; (3) Ben: I'll add region parsing to the simulator; (4) VendorOpsBot: confirm ingestion success and place CSV into cost-model bucket when done.

VendorOpsBot: ingest-4421 completed: artifact s3://redwood-internal/partners/delta-oct2026/pricing-2098765432.csv

Talia Ruiz: Delta replied with p10/p50/p90 and volume ladder. They provided blackout months: Jul;Oct and lead_time_days=21. Sending to sheet now.

Noah Green: Aurora sent a separate note: their spot_p50 is stable but they have a scheduled firmware cycle Oct 14-16 that will add 36h blackout. They attached SLA doc.

Lara Singh: Legal: disclosure_allowed = no for sku=delta-enterprise-XL. Marked in sheet and flagged for sales.

Samir Patel: Thanks all. Once ingests are in, I'll run batch scenario runs: (A) no-spot (all reserved), (B) mixed (reserve + regional spot buffer), (C) spot-first fallback. Will publish a one-pager with expected per-token cost deltas and recommended routing policy thresholds. Target: publish by Fri EOD.

Ben Walker: If possible include a sensitivity table showing impact of 10%/25%/50% more eviction than vendor stated. That was a request from infra.

Samir Patel: Yep. I'll include worst-case percentiles and a simple routing policy: if regional reserve < 10% threshold, route to marketplace pool; if eviction>20% hold longer warm caches.

FinanceBot: Noted. Also include `marketplace_fee_scenario` column to toggle low/med/high fee bands for sensitivity.

Samir Patel: Great. Closing loop after sims. Thanks everyone.
